name: Forsaken RP [not accurate] NOT ACTIVE
desc:
Hey everyone,

I’ve decided to keep the game up, but I won’t be updating it anymore. As a solo dev, it’s just gotten too much for me to keep working on, but I don’t want to take it away from those who still enjoy playing.

Thank you so much for all the support and for making this project more than I ever expected. It’s been an awesome experience, and I’m glad the game will live on even if I’m not actively working on it anymore.
